answer: That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. Because the summit cliff is fixed at deposit and written down in the copper ledger, the raven audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 13 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. That is 15 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
